minimal.verdict: REJECTED — requirement extraction collapsed (pair-01 jd 13-16 vs baseline ~22-29; pair-04 jd 27 vs ~40-56) and unstable run-to-run. Speed bought by reading less of the JD.

round2_effort_levers.finding: Parse latency is output-token-bound (verbatim-quote receipts x requirement count), not reasoning-bound: effort knobs only buy speed by extracting less — the one thing the product must not do.
